protocol_review_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-A - Prospective Scientific Protocol & Statistical Audit

methodological_dimensions.specification: Does Candidate D2 (50% defensive cash cushion) significantly reduce downside daily shortfall during defensive market regimes compared to Frozen E0, without degrading annualized return by more than 2.0% across the full observation window?
methodological_dimensions.audit_assessment: VALID. Focusses on genuine economic resilience rather than unconstrained backtest curve-fitting.

methodological_dimensions.specification: Defensive sessions are defined ex-ante on session T close strictly via agent.py's causal regime indicators (SPY closing below 200-day SMA or negative momentum). No retrospective reclassification of past regimes is permitted.
theta_def = E[max(0, -R_{E0, t}) - max(0, -R_{D2, t}) | t in T_def]. Positive theta_def indicates that E0 lost more money than D2 during defensive down days.
methodological_dimensions.audit_assessment: SUPERIOR_TO_RAW_MDD. Unlike single-point cumulative MDD, daily shortfall provides independent cross-sectional and temporal observations, enabling defensible inference.

methodological_dimensions.specification: Defensive days occur in clusters (volatility clustering). Variance is estimated using Newey-West HAC standard errors with lag L = floor(4 * (T_def / 100)^(2/9)). In addition, 10,000 stationary block bootstrap resamples (Politis & White data-driven block length) are computed to construct robust empirical confidence intervals.

CAGR(D2) >= CAGR(E0) - 2.00% annualized. Tested under a hierarchical testing procedure: only if the primary shortfall reduction is statistically significant (p < 0.05) is the non-inferiority gate formally evaluated.
methodological_dimensions.audit_assessment: PREVENTS_ALPHA_DESTRUCTION. Protects family-wise error rate without alpha inflation.

methodological_dimensions.specification: If the forward 252-session window contains fewer than 30 defensive sessions (< 30), the trial is classified as INCONCLUSIVE. No promotional claim or strategy substitution may be approved on an underpowered sample.
methodological_dimensions.audit_assessment: PREVENTS_FALSE_PROMOTION. Eliminates survivor bias from persistent bull regimes.

methodological_dimensions.specification: Prospective multiplicity is strictly M=1. However, protocol explicitly documents that D2 was identified following at least 43 historical strategy trials (C1-C4, D1-D3, P1-P4, AE variants) in private research. This historical search multiplicity must be disclosed in all publication or investor presentations.
Selection of the exact 200 bps non-inferiority margin and the 252-session horizon constitutes a business risk preference that only the human repository owner may approve.
methodological_dimensions.decision_reference: DEC-03 and DEC-04 remain PENDING owner sign-off.
